name: Bila Cinta Menjadi Dosa
overview: A family-centered thriller, operating with a consistent undercurrent of psychological pressure. The story follows Zhafran (Zairi Aziz) returning from abroad to face unresolved friction involving his controlling father, Dato’ Yusof (Zamarul Hisham). The tension escalates significantly with the bold entrance of Eva (played with sharp charisma by Che Puan Sarimah Ibrahim), whose allegations of an affair with the patriarch dismantle the family’s protective wall of wealth and reputation.
